payload.job: Publish one selected interactive experience behind its exact logical, byte, identity, and access authority.
invariants: Only a committed publication is buyer reachable.
Runtime Kit apply proof is the only projected-byte membership authority.
The logical authority manifest never copies projected byte membership.
Every protected operation reauthorizes current identity and access.
No package-set root, Studio shell, package catalog, or unrestricted target is projected.

things.name: public-entry-server
things.why_this_exists: The server that answers a public address was the one process in this package with no way to be built, so nothing could carry it to a machine and nothing started it. A host then answered every address from whatever sat behind it, which is how one shell served one document to every visitor and every person's work landed in the same place.

invariants: Every root is an exact address/revision/object-hash reference.
The entry byte path must be selected transitively.
No package-set identity is accepted.
status active is written only after materialize/create/sign/apply/deploy succeed.
All linked records use exact address/revision/object-hash references.
share_url is accepted only from the one validated publication-deployment-result/v1 artifact.
The publication stores an exact route_ref and never duplicates share_url.
Public policy has zero required access refs.
Signed policy names a verifier target.
Account policy accepts identity only from Account Session.
Records are caller-ready owner values.
The process never opens EEAF, a log, package folders, or owner-private storage.

payload.name: publish-selected-experience
payload.description: Materialize caller-ready selected roots, seal and verify their exact bytes, deploy through the package-owned provider action, then write the buyer-reachable publication.

payload.name: deploy-container-artifact

payload.caller_input_contract: Only the exact persisted publication-request identity, its exact selected intent identity, and its opaque request key cross this boundary. The owner exact-reads and cross-checks the request before resolving dependencies, policy, the bounded deployment request, roots, manifests, and publication results.

The creator supplies only a surface-owner materializer descriptor address, opaque owner-local selection input, materialization UUID, and canonical policy/destination addresses. Hosted Public App resolves current observations and exact authority records, generates the opaque publication request key, and persists the normalized request before admitted Workflow publication.

payload.title: Hosted experience
payload.description: Publish one selected experience without exposing the Studio workspace.

invariants: publication_request_key is server-generated cryptographically random opaque state and is persisted on first normalization.
The caller never supplies publication_request_key, package-set identity, executable process data, closure inputs, route identity, offer identity, carrier identity, or result identity.
The package target descriptor is bound by its current Engine observation `{address, object_hash}`; target descriptors are not fabricated as semantic exact references.

A retry reads this request by its persisted canonical identity and requires exact equality of selected_root_refs, selection_ref, materializer_descriptor_observation, policy_ref, seller_authority_ref, and publication_destination_ref.
Same canonical request identity plus any normalized-field drift is a conflict.

selection_normalization.input: a selected owner package-target-descriptor address, opaque materialization identity, and seller choice address labels
selection_normalization.normalizer: owner materializer invocation followed by exact root/authority readback
selection_normalization.offer_ingress: one exact-read current Checkout offer descriptor address or one bounded HPA-authored new offer; never both.

payload.execution: policy and destination exact-read owner data carry the matching Workflow execution descriptor; payment timing and currency remain Checkout-owned Society data.

invariants: package-set DATA selects a profile owned by hosted-public-app and supplies bounded parameter values only.
the generic package owns the executable, arguments, allowed environment variable names, and result extraction.
adding a provider capability changes the generic package and its tests, never an application package set.

materialization and deploy share one contained publication workspace; run-provider-deploy.mjs reads the selected site as a direct child and writes exactly one deployment-result.json under publication-deployment-result/v1.

payload.name: reserve-public-selection-transition
payload.description: CAS-reserve a generation+digest-bound public selection while preserving the stable release.

payload.name: finalize-public-selection-transition
payload.description: CAS-finalize a reserved public selection only after exact provider commit and convergence evidence exist.

payload.name: reconcile-public-selection-transition
payload.description: CAS-clear a failed or ambiguous reservation while retaining the previously stable public release.
